glossary.definition: (A)(1) "Cable service provider" has the same meaning as in section 1332.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 1349.10 - Internet age verification - obscenity or matter harmful to juveniles.

glossary.definition: (2) "Cloud service provider" means a third-party company offering a cloud-based platform, infrastructure, application, or storage services.
glossary.source_title: Section 1349.10 - Internet age verification - obscenity or matter harmful to juveniles.

glossary.definition: (3) "Direct-to-home satellite service" has the same meaning as in 47 U.S.C. 303, as amended.
glossary.source_title: Section 1349.10 - Internet age verification - obscenity or matter harmful to juveniles.

glossary.definition: (4) "Identifying information" means photo identification or public or private transactional data.
glossary.source_title: Section 1349.10 - Internet age verification - obscenity or matter harmful to juveniles.

glossary.definition: (5) "Interactive computer service" has the same meaning as in the "Telecommunications Act of 1996," 47 U.S.C. 230, as amended.
glossary.source_title: Section 1349.10 - Internet age verification - obscenity or matter harmful to juveniles.

glossary.definition: (9) "Photo identification" has the same meaning as in section 3501.01 of the Revised Code and includes any government-issued identification issued by another state, district, country, or sovereignty.
glossary.source_title: Section 1349.10 - Internet age verification - obscenity or matter harmful to juveniles.
Section 1349.10 - Internet age verification - obscenity or matter harmful to juveniles.

glossary.definition: (11) "Transactional data" means a sequence of information that documents an exchange, agreement, or transfer between a person, organization, or third party for the purpose of satisfying a request or event. "Transactional data" includes mortgage, educational, and employment records.
